stan-átha, m. roar of the lion (RV.¹);
 🞄-áthu, m. id. (AV.).

stanáyad-ama, a. having a roaring 🞄onset (Maruts;
 RV.¹).
stana-vepathu, m. heaving of the 🞄breast.
stana‿uttarīya, n. breast-cloth.

stan-ya, a. contained in the motherʼs 🞄breast;
 n. milk (contained in the female 🞄breast or the udder): -tyāga, m. leaving off 🞄the motherʼs milk, being weaned: -mātraka, a. w. vayas, n. period of life immediately 🞄after weaning.

 = section (in books the titles of 🞄which contain latā, mañjarī etc.).
stabaka-ya, den. P. provide with 🞄clusters of blossoms: pp. ita.

stabhā-yá, P. (V.) fix, support;
 🞄stop, arrest.
stambá, m. bunch, tuft (esp. of grass): 🞄-kari, a. forming bunches: -tā, f. formation 🞄of (abundant) sheaves or clusters (of rice).
stambe-rama, m. (delighting in 🞄tufts of grass), elephant.
STAMBH, v. स्तभ् STABH.
stambhī-bhū, become a post.
star-aṇa, n. [stṛ] act of strewing or 🞄scattering.
starī́, f. (nm. -s) barren or non-pregnant 🞄cow, heifer (V.).
staru, m. enemy (S.).
star-tavai, d. inf. √ stṛ (Br.).

stāv-a, m. [√ stu] praise, panegyric: 🞄-ka, a. praising;
 m. praiser, panegyrist.
stavara-ka, m. n. kind of fabric or 🞄stuff.
stava-rāja, m. chief of panegyrics.

stav-e, 3 sg. pr. with ps. mg. of √ stu 🞄(V.);
 -āna, pr. pt. Ā. (V.).
stav-ya, fp. to be praised, praiseworthy.
STĀ, Ⅳ. P. only pr. pt. stāyát, stealthy, 🞄clandestine (AV., very rare).

stā-yú, m. thief (VS.;
 = tāyu).
